purpose: Pointwise expression-capacity/conditioning audit of the Eq. (4.5) profile mixing, independent of any chosen v0/F/U basis.

findings.axis_rank: 1 because the v0 and F columns vanish at r=0
findings.channel_orthogonality: analytic; sampled normalized cross-dot is numerical zero
findings.near_axis_conditioning: raw pointwise condition grows like 1/r because radial/swirl profile values become unobservable on axis
findings.minimal_handoff: Do not add a fourth Cartesian velocity channel merely to cure the axis rank loss. Keep Eq. (4.5) mixing and spend basis growth on the 2D profiles v0(X,eta), F(X,eta), U(X,eta), with channel normalization/weights when fitting near-axis samples.

truth_boundary: This does not solve q(z,t,h), choose profile bases, fit a field, compare an image, or validate Navier-Stokes.
